message.content:
I replaced the deep copies with moves from the source vectors, eliminating allocations and memory copies when the source is a temporary (as in the decoder’s field insertion path).

```include
#include <utility>
```
```cpp
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(std::move(const_cast<FieldBase&>(field).values)),
      stringIndexes(std::move(const_cast<FieldBase&>(field).stringIndexes))
{
}
```
